title: core.event.v1 WalletStateChanged payload
description: A wallet's state as the core holds it (ticket 67, spec 18.7, D5): published on create, on every status change and in a snapshot of every wallet (dev, on start). version only grows for a wallet (also across a core reset); a consumer keeps the state of the highest version it saw and ignores an equal or lower one, so duplicates, snapshots and out-of-order delivery are harmless. Only wallets a person logs in to (with an MSISDN) are published, never system wallets.

status.description: LOCKED = the core's PIN lockout; BLOCKED and HOLD = compliance states.

hasPin.description: false: the wallet must set a first PIN (spec 18.7 login step 4).

birthYear.description: When the core has it (weak-PIN rule).
